children.value: > Fact From Story: Meta's move to offer users a subscription or tracking hasn’t been signed off by data protection authorities as yet — and it’s clear that further regulatory interventions could follow.

> > Fact From Story: Norway’s DPA, which has a local ban order on Meta’s tracking ads, told us it’s concerned about the subscription plan, saying it has doubts as to whether it would constitute valid consent.
> > > Fact From Story: The DPC has been engaged in a detailed regulatory assessment of the consent-based model since it was first proposed by Meta in July.
> > > Fact From Story: Meta is already in the Commission’s sights over its approach to the DSA.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Regulatory assessments can lead to regulatory interventions.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A product that does not have valid consent is not approved.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Something cannot be implemented until it is approved.
